mechanics.statFormula: floor(2 * baseStat * level / 100) + 5; multiply and truncate by clamped stat modifier [0.25,4]
mechanics.damageFormula: AS3 truncates to int at each assignment: floor(2*level/5), +2, floor(value*attack*power/defense), floor(value/50), +2, floor(value*STAB), floor(value*effectiveness); crit doubles result.
mechanics.experienceAwardFormula: floor(enemyBaseExperience * enemyLevel / (7 * numberOfUniqueAttackers)); multiply by expIncrease; recipients with nonzero shiny get +50%; level-specific bonus may double award.
mechanics.rangeMode: Original uses range MovieClip hitTestObject against enemy gfx, not a per-move distance.
mechanics.cooldownUnit: Original game ticks (one per main.enterFrame update); game speed can perform extra updates.
